# Project plan

## Goals
- Ship the sync daemon
- Keep history append-only
- Document the wire format

## Timeline
Week 1: replication core
Week 2: encryption layer
Week 3: history module
Week 4: integration and polish

## Risks
Clock skew between devices could reorder filenames.
Fuzzy patching must never show silent garbage.

## Notes
The vault is the source of truth.
History files ride the same sync as everything else.

## Goals

- Keep history append-only
- Document the wire format

Week 2: encryption layer

Clock skew between devices could reorder filenames.

History files ride the same sync as everything else.
